summary: This tutorial explains how to customize slide backgrounds and designs in LibreOffice Impress on GNU/Linux. It starts by opening a sample presentation file and then demonstrates how to apply a custom background to all slides using the slide master feature. To do this, you select the slide master, modify the master slide, and apply changes to all slides. The tutorial also covers setting text colors and fonts for clarity against the background. It shows how to add elements like logos and shapes to presentations using the basic shapes toolbar. Additionally, it guides users through adjusting the size and position of objects on slides using handles and control points. Overall, the tutorial provides step-by-step instructions for enhancing the visual appeal of presentations in LibreOffice Impress.
